intro: A Difficult Path marks the formal beginning of a Forsaken paladin's training in Deathknell. After dealing with the mindless undead rising from the crypts, newly awakened champions of the Light are directed to Aramis Hammerhand within the village church to confront the agonizing reality of wielding holy energy in undeath.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. It reeks of the light, so I imagine it's of some importance to an adventurer like yourself.
Read it before heading out again. Just please--step away when you do. Adventurers make me quite uneasy.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your training can now begin in earnest, adventurer. I see great promise in you, but take care not to turn away from the light, even for a moment. Embrace the pain it will cause you. That pain is a crucible, and you will emerge from it stronger than you ever were in your previous life.
